      "compound_chembl_id",

      "molecule_dictionary",
      "molecule_hierarchy",
      "compound_structures",
      "compound_records",
      "activities",
      "assays",
      "docs",
      "target_dictionary"
    ],
    "Join": [
      "molecule_dictionary parent ON parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3182437'",
      "molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno",
      "molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno",
      "compound_structures ON child.molregno = compound_structures.molregno",
      "compound_records ON child.molregno = compound_records.molregno",
      "activities ON compound_records.record_id = activities.record_id",
      "assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id",
      "docs ON activities.doc_id = docs.doc_id",
      "target_dictionary ON activities.tid = target_dictionary.tid"
    ],
    "Filter": [
      "target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3430885'",
      "activities.standard_type = 'IC50'"
    ],
    "Sort": [
      "compound_chembl_id ASC",
      "canonical_smiles ASC",
      "compound_key ASC",
      "pubmed_id_or_doi ASC",
      "assay_description ASC",
      "standard_type ASC",

      "standard_units ASC",
      "activity_comment ASC",
      "target_chembl_id ASC",
      "target_name ASC",

    ],
    "Limit": null
  }
}
